# sentry_organization_member (Data Source)

Looks up a member of the organization by email address, for example to put an existing member on a team with `sentry_team_member`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sentry_organization_member" "jane" {
  email = "jane@example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) Email address of the member (case-insensitive).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Organization member ID. It is not the user's ID.
- `pending` (Boolean) Whether the member's invitation is still waiting to be accepted.
- `role` (String) Organization role of the member.
